providers.name: Sarah Mitchell Vocal Studio
providers.tagline: Musical theatre voice specialist — belt, mix, legit
providers.description: Private vocal coaching for musical theatre performers of all levels. Specialising in belt technique, mix voice, and audition preparation. 15+ years performing and teaching across Melbourne's community and professional theatre scene.

providers.name: TurnOut Dance Academy
providers.tagline: Jazz, tap, ballet & MT dance for performers
providers.description: Melbourne's premier dance training for musical theatre performers. Classes in jazz, tap, ballet, and contemporary with a focus on theatre-style choreography. Adult beginner classes available — perfect for singers wanting to strengthen their movement skills.

providers.name: Michael Chen — Acting & Scene Work
providers.tagline: Meisner-trained. Scene work, monologues & cold reading
providers.description: One-on-one and small group acting coaching with a focus on truthful, grounded performance. Meisner technique adapted for musical theatre. Ideal for performers wanting to strengthen their acting in book scenes and audition sides.

providers.name: Alex Rossi — Audition Accompanist
providers.tagline: Reliable keys for your next audition or rehearsal
providers.description: Experienced accompanist available for auditions, rehearsals, and private coaching sessions. Comfortable sight-reading all MT repertoire. Can also provide transpositions and cut arrangements on request.

providers.name: Spotlight Studios — Performer Headshots
providers.description: Specialising in performer headshots for musical theatre, acting, and dance. Natural light studio and outdoor options. Quick turnaround — edited gallery within 48 hours. Packages include retouching, multiple looks, and digital delivery.

providers.name: Triple Threat Coaching
providers.tagline: Complete audition preparation — song, scene, dance
providers.description: Full-service audition coaching covering song selection, interpretation, monologue work, and dance combination prep. Run by a team of three specialists (singer, actor, dancer) who work together to prepare you for the whole audition room.

providers.name: Stagewear Costumes Melbourne
providers.tagline: Costume hire & custom builds for community theatre
providers.description: Extensive costume hire library for musical theatre productions, plus custom builds for specific shows. Period costumes, character pieces, and ensemble packages available. Discounts for community theatre companies.

providers.name: Ballarat School of Dance
providers.tagline: Regional Victoria's home for musical theatre dance
providers.description: Offering jazz, tap, ballet, and contemporary classes with a strong musical theatre focus. Located in the heart of Ballarat, serving regional performers who want to build their dance skills without travelling to Melbourne every week.
